# LGD Ventures

> LGD Ventures is a small, independent software studio that builds private, single-purpose browser extensions for people who work online. Products keep user data on the user's device: no accounts and no analytics in the extensions.

Contact: lgdventures.hq@gmail.com · Site: https://lgdventures.github.io/
Facts below are as of Oct 2026.

## Products

- [ChatCairn](https://lgdventures.github.io/chatcairn/): a Chrome extension for people who use AI chatbots that saves ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok chats into one local, searchable library, exports them to Markdown or PDF, and turns highlights into notes and tasks. Free: up to 50 saved chats and 10 notes/tasks (exports carry a small "Made with ChatCairn" line). Pro: $4.99/month or $39 one-time, sold on the ChatCairn site. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/mnpjimmmommjcaoblccngodapolhamlc · Edge Add-ons: https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/hgaggannjdbhnbmaffgeiiajopmedkhi (version 0.4.0, live on both).
- [MeetCrate](https://lgdventures.github.io/meetcrate/): a Chrome and Edge extension for Read AI users that exports every meeting at once (transcripts, summaries and action items as Markdown, TXT, SRT or JSON in one ZIP) through Read AI's official sign-in, read-only. Free: the 10 most recent meetings. Pro: $29 one-time, sold on the MeetCrate site. Live on Microsoft Edge Add-ons; Chrome Web Store coming soon.
- [BackTrail](https://lgdventures.github.io/backtrail/): a Chrome and Edge extension that keeps every tab's full Back history in the side panel, restores it after the browser restarts, and recovers history that was already lost. Free; nothing leaves the browser. Live on Microsoft Edge Add-ons: https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/pefddbpjdboihonoknjogogmckhpogpf; Chrome Web Store coming soon. Pro ($15 one-time) coming soon.
